Tooth 75 is listed for extraction while the examination lists carious lesions on teeth 54, 64, 74 and 85; whether 75 or 74 is meant is not stated.

The patient accepted the proposed dental treatment (restorations of 54 and 64, extraction of 85 and 75, Nance lingual arch). Only the restorations are stated as performed; the extractions are proposed and the Nance arch is stated as chosen. The Figure 4A caption shows "space maintainer installed" without naming it the Nance arch.
The levothyroxine sodium entry is written "25mcg, box of 30 Tablets, the ideal being 3 mcg/kg/day"; whether 25mcg is the tablet strength or the administered dose, and the frequency, are not stated.

claims.text: Treatment was multidisciplinary, initially levothyroxine sodium hormone replacement, and dental care with restorations of teeth 54 and 64 in resin-modified glass ionomer cement. Extraction of teeth 85 and 75 and a Nance lingual arch space maintainer were part of the proposed dental treatment. Intraoral photos after 6 months of treatment show birth of the maxillary and mandibular central incisors, upper lateral exfoliation and an installed space maintainer. One year after the first visit, eruption corresponding to the chronology of age was verified, and the authors report an improved quality of life.
